description: Detect which applicant-tracking system (ATS) a company publishes its public job board on, and its board token. Reads the company's careers page (or a given careers_url) for a Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Recruitee/BambooHR/Workday/Workable/Teamtailor/Personio/Jobvite/Breezy/Pinpoint/Rippling/iCIMS link; falls back to slug-probing the domain name against each board API that supports it. Does not read any private/Harvest-key ATS data — only what a public job board already exposes. Discoveries persist so repeat lookups for the same domain are instant.

careers_url.description: A specific careers-page URL to scan instead of guessing one from domain, e.g. "https://www.airbnb.com/careers".

domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "airbnb.com" (no scheme, no path).

name: ats_detect
title: Ats Detect
